caption: The drawing depicts a large bronze or brass bell mounted horizontally within a sturdy metal frame. The frame includes four legs that curve outward at the base, providing stable support. Attached to the left side of the frame is a large spoked wheel, which appears to be part of a mechanism for ringing the bell. The bell itself is traditional in shape, with a flared bottom lip and a pronounced ridge near its crown. The clapper, colored in a darker tone, hangs inside the bell and is visible below its lowest edge. The metallic components are mostly shades of brown and gray, with hints of greenish and yellowish tones to suggest age or patina. The background is plain and uniformly off-white, and there is a small signature “W. Riefkohl” towards the lower right of the bell.
title: Elementary School Bell
